t: This is the Marx Memorial Library, a library, archive and education charity focused on Marxist and wider socialist work. It takes its name from Karl Marx, the German philosopher who co-wrote The Communist Manifesto with Friedrich Engels and went on to write Das Kapital. His ideas, known as Marxism, have had enormous influence on intellectual, political and social history. The material I have also links his youngest daughter, Eleanor Marx, to the place. She was a writer, translator and activist who translated her father's writings and helped spread his ideas.
